14:16 Local Time, 12:16 GMT, 17:46 IST: Brevis takes the helmet off and congratulates Connor Esterhuizen for his knock. South Africa sweep the series 3-0. Namibia tried something different today and decided to bat, but Fortuin recorded his career-best figures to trigger a collapse that saw the hosts slip from 72/2 to 125/9. They needed at least 300 to challenge the Proteas but they folded for 156. The visitors opted for the heavy roller to ease the pitch slightly and their openers Esterhuizen and Hermann got them off to a great start, sharing a 150-run opening stand. South Africa were just too good with bat and ball throughout the series for Namibia.

Ruben Trumpelmann is the bowler of the tournament

Jordan Hermann is the batter of the tournament

Hermann is also the Player of the Series

Namibia believe they are a better side than how they played in this series and are hoping to upskill before their next series, while the Proteas travel home to host the Aussies in what is expected to be a spicy series. They will be really happy with the way their top order used their chances in this series, while the spinners have a great run too. They were pleased with how their pacers were quite penetrative too. Namibia started the T20 tri-series with a bang by upsetting the Proteas but they lost their way and went on to lose this ODI series 0-3. That's curtains then for today. We will see you on all again another day on our cricket journey. Take great care!
